author: Subtile
body:
Hello,

This is Dynamo. I haven't been on Avicus for a long time due to other reasons and working on a big project (something to do with a server and possibly talking to the owners about it - (I am getting off topic). I was banned on this account for hacking, which I regret. I was banned for flying which is stupid of me and I am most likely making a return with a new account because I might be selling Jerseys.

I regret what I have done and this is basically a new 'life' for this account. 

Good things are too come.

Thank you, 

Factored or Dynamo.
